name: Atlas (Electric)
summary: All-electric Atlas developed with automotive partners.
specs_note: height_cm, weight_kg, payload_kg, degrees_of_freedom, runtime_minutes and reach_cm verified by the product owner against Boston Dynamics' own current Atlas product page (2026-08-18), superseding the earlier pre-catalogue internal-record height_cm value (150 cm). payload_kg records Boston Dynamics' 30 kg SUSTAINED capacity; the manufacturer separately states a 50 kg INSTANTANEOUS capacity, which this schema has no second field for and is recorded here rather than dropped. Boston Dynamics also states an IP67 ingress-protection rating, for which this schema has no structured field; recorded here for the same reason. mobility and has_manipulation remain from the earlier internal-record pass, not yet independently re-confirmed against the manufacturer page. SPECIFICATIONS (HO-DATA-30 batch 3, 2026-10-22): has_vision, has_teleoperation filled from first-party Boston Dynamics sources, each quoted in spec_caveats. Capability booleans are set only where the manufacturer states the capability in words (HO-DATA-30 mapping rules, docs/audit/HO-DATA-30_FEASIBILITY_AND_BATCH3_2026-10-22.md); a negative only where it is stated in words.
